modules.base: Allocation, arenas, assertions, messages, scalar types, and worker primitives.
modules.builder: Compact geometry construction, decomposition, import, and Qhull adapters.
modules.collision: Broadphase, narrowphase, continuous collision detection, and spatial queries.
modules.containers: Arrays, hashes, sets, heaps, lists, and related storage contracts.
modules.controllers: Constraints, actuators, force systems, buoyancy, and vehicle controllers.
modules.diagnostics: Counters, statistics, debug managers, and benchmark instrumentation.
modules.dynamics: World, object, core, scheduling, cluster, and simulation lifecycle.
modules.events: Object, collision, and PSI listener delivery.
modules.geometry: Compact surfaces, ledges, grids, trees, and surface managers.
modules.math: Vectors, matrices, quaternions, transforms, and geometry helpers.
modules.render: Optional SDL3 GPU rendering and example presentation support.
modules.solver: Impact, contact, friction, dense matrix, and constraint solving.
modules.utility: Active values, strings, hashing, interpolation, and union-find helpers.

configurations.asan-ubsan: Debug build with address and undefined-behavior sanitizers.
configurations.debug-mainline: Default mainline policy in Debug with assertions and reference debug paths.
configurations.examples-headless: Optional render/examples build with every example run without a window.
configurations.float-mainline: Default mainline policy with IVP_REAL_DOUBLE disabled.
configurations.reference-development: Reference internals plus classic Qhull for strict 48-scenario comparison.
configurations.release-mainline: Default double-precision Release policy on Linux, macOS, and Windows.
configurations.scenario-invariants: Release scenario runner with all registered invariant checks enabled.
configurations.tsan: Clang Debug build with ThreadSanitizer over the threading contract suite.

properties.bit-exact-reference: Observable output exactly matches the strict C++ reference domain.
properties.execution-mode-equivalence: Serial and supported parallel execution modes produce identical visible state.
properties.failure-atomicity: Rejected or failed operations do not leave partially published state.
properties.headless-smoke: The optional presentation path initializes and advances without a GPU window.
properties.internal-history-independence: Allocator, container, scratch, and registration history do not change visible physics.
properties.lifecycle-safety: Creation, mutation, deferred work, and teardown preserve ownership contracts.
properties.long-horizon-stability: Representative simulations remain finite and physically bounded over long runs.
properties.module-contract: Focused unit tests cover the module's public and internal contracts.
properties.parallel-work-dispatch: Tests require the intended worker path to execute, rather than only comparing fallbacks.
properties.public-event-order: Public callbacks and event traces have a stable semantic order.
properties.race-freedom: Concurrent execution is exercised under ThreadSanitizer.
properties.reference-values: Focused differential cases retain values captured from the reference engine.
properties.registered-mainline-differences: The default policy produces exactly the reviewed reference-difference inventory.
properties.scenario-invariants: End-to-end scenarios enforce finite state and feature-specific physical invariants.
properties.state-hash-stability: Benchmark and replay workloads retain their expected state or trajectory hashes.

features.name: Collision detection and spatial queries
features.summary: Broadphase, filtering, continuous collision detection, ray casts, sphere queries, and collision-difference bookkeeping.

features.name: Compact geometry and builders
features.summary: Compact surfaces, grids, convex and concave builders, BVH construction, content import, and both Qhull backends.

features.name: Constraints and actuators
features.summary: Springs, motors, forces, buoyancy, force fields, attachment, limits, and controller registration and teardown.

features.name: Contact, impact, and friction solving
features.summary: Impact response, persistent contacts, friction systems, dense matrices, LCS, and solver-core reactions.

features.name: Diagnostics and performance measurement
features.summary: Statistics, counters, benchmark profiles, state hashes, allocation accounting, and long-horizon regression workloads.

features.name: Events and world services
features.summary: Listener delivery, phantoms, active values, anomaly handling, universe callbacks, and environment-owned services.

features.name: Foundation math and utility types
features.summary: Scalar rules, vectors, matrices, quaternions, transforms, active values, strings, interpolation, and utility helpers.

features.name: Internal-state stability
features.summary: Visible physics remains unchanged across allocator histories, container layouts, scratch contents, registration histories, and supported execution modes.

features.name: Memory and containers
features.summary: Allocator failure handling, unified arenas, reusable registries, arrays, maps, sets, heaps, lists, and deferred deletion.

features.name: Concurrent multi-world execution
features.summary: Persistent scheduling of independent environments with serial fallback, batch validation, overlap, and bit-exact results.

features.name: Reference alignment
features.summary: Strict Release and Debug comparison against the C++ engine, plus an exact inventory for deliberate default-policy differences.

features.name: Rigid-body world lifecycle
features.summary: Environment, object, core, cluster, simulation-unit, merge, attachment, mutation, and teardown behavior.

features.name: Single-world parallelism
features.summary: Per-environment indexed broadphase and solver kernels plus safe independent-island dispatch with exact serial fallback.

features.name: Vehicles and specialized controllers
